findings.source_quote: Please join us in prayer for Brother Joe and his family as he and his wife face the end of their lives

findings.source_quote: Springtime, along with the normal planting season, was extra long and drawn out. But, by now, most of what is known locally as “the spring work” has been finished.
findings.suggested_fix: 改为“春季连同通常的播种季节，都格外漫长。但到现在，本地人所称的‘春季农活’大多已经完成。”
findings.translation_quote: 春季和正常的播种季节相比，格外漫长而延宕。但现在，本地人所称的“大多数春季工作”已接近完成。
